_fixture_notice: SYNTHETIC. Invented by hand, not exported from any Foundry world. The field paths and their presence/absence match the structure verified against two real dnd5e 5.3.3 Actor exports on 2026-07-30 (docs/discovery/foundry-mapping.md section 4, findings F-F1 to F-F5). Values are synthetic; the shape is the contract.
_fixture_shape: Manual-export shape: '_id' is null and the real actor ID survives only in the filename (F-F1). Derived values are absent rather than precomputed (F-F2): no abilities.*.mod, no attributes.prof, hp.max is null, ac.flat is null, and system.details.level does not exist.

_fixture_expected_mapping.external_actor_id_source: Not present in the document body: an export carries '_id': null (F-F1), so the ID comes from the Foundry module/API, or in this fixture from _fixture_export_filename. A mapping must never be established from an export alone.
_fixture_expected_mapping.platform_owner: resolved via Council-managed character_access, never by name match

derived_must_be_computed.proficiency bonus: computed from level; system.attributes.prof is absent (F-F2)
derived_must_be_computed.hit points maximum: attributes.hp.max is null; Foundry computes it at runtime (F-F2)
derived_must_be_computed.armour class: attributes.ac.flat is null and calc may be 'custom' with a formula string (F-F2)
derived_must_be_computed.character level: sum of items[type=class].system.levels; system.details.level does not exist (F-F2)

tool_vocabulary._note: system.tools keys are artisan names, the same vocabulary as Sheet columns W/X (F-F3). Three aliases are required.
tool_vocabulary.alchemist: Alchemist (value 2 = expertise; Freedom Blades has three ranks, so rank cannot round-trip)
tool_vocabulary.lute: instrument, not a crafting tool: must not imply a crafting rank

bastion._note: Complementary ownership, not a conflict (F-F4). Sheet flags stay database-owned; Foundry facilities are imported read-only as evidence.
bastion.coverage: Opt-in and incomplete. An empty facility list means 'not recorded', never 'no Bastion'. Store what was observed with its observation time.

unresolved.system.details.xp.value: D&D experience. NOT Sheet column G, which is a mission count. Never reconcile the two.
unresolved.character level: Rules section 3.1 p.9-10 derive level from cumulative mission count and require Council approval. See OD-15.
unresolved.system.tools.*: dnd5e models proficient/expertise only; Freedom Blades has three artisan ranks. Rank cannot round-trip. See field-ownership.md section 5.
unresolved.inventory: The Sheet holds curated names only; Foundry holds everything. No join key beyond fuzzy name comparison. See OD-13.
